drawRules.rule: From day -1 through tournament end inspect official singles qualifying and main draws. A player found in either draw stays permanently without an acceptance label. Absence removes the player only when both singles draws are populated and reliable. Missing, error, empty or bye-only draws are inconclusive and preserve the last valid acceptance state.
